answer: Beacon spot-checks stop bulk fakes. At dawn, the beacon issues a challenge; each agent must answer in 10 minutes with a heartbeat proving work. A whisper of idle activity fails: a sleeper cannot fake months of logs, and a raven with one forged proof aids one identity, each heartbeat binding to one key. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits against 800 in rewards: a loss. An honest agent pays 30 and keeps undiluted rewards.
